intro.text: A sea on Roshar, scattered with islands and home to the Tai-na, enormous greatshells that people live on.
The largest known sea on Roshar, filling a large part of the continent's centre. The Reshi Isles lie at its northern end, and Marabethia separates its southern end from the Purelake.

description.text: It is deeper than the Purelake, yet shallow enough for the Tai-na, island-sized greatshells worshipped as gods, to walk along the bottom.
Its coasts are shared by Iri, Rira, Babatharnam, Tu Bayla, Herdaz and Jah Keved. In the Heraldic Epochs it lay within the Silver Kingdom of Rishir.

The Reshi live on many of its islands, and some Tai-na carry small kingdoms of their own that draw foreigners seeking a simpler life. Ashir and Geranid, two ardents, keep a small island there for their experiments.
The region is hot, humid and tropical, and it never snows. The water is usually calm and warm.
